meta.method: For each day a person sat in the federal parliament: the parliamentary base salary then in force, plus the additional salary of the post they then held, as a percentage of that base. A Minister is paid the one ministerial rate that applies. Other office holders are paid the sum of the percentages of their offices, rounded up to the next $10; a shadow minister is paid a flat rate instead. Yearly figures add those days across a financial year. Nothing is adjusted for inflation.

not_covered.text: Committee chairs and deputy chairs are paid a further 3% to 16% that is not counted, because the Parliamentary Handbook gives no dates for who chaired what.
A shadow minister is paid a loading only if named in the Opposition Leader’s notice to the Clerks, which is capped and not published; Opax assumes every listed shadow minister is named.
